entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Eiko Takao-san. You've been[n]spending time in the red-light[n]district lately, haven't you?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Both myself and [fName]-kun[n]here saw you there.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Based on where you were heading,[n]we assume you're working at a store[n]called the After School Salon.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: How is it, working there?

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: Whaddya mean? It's just a normal[n]café. They make me wear a costume[n]and stuff, but that's it.

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: Oh, and I don't hafta do anything[n]weird, if you know what I mean.[n]It's all totally legal.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hm. So you're sure nothing[n]strange is going on?

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: Yup yup, the worst I get is some[n]weird old guys gawking at me.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I see... Beyond that though,[n]why are you working there?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...How's your financial situation?

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: Uh, fine? I mean, I can just ask[n]my parents for cash whenever I want.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: O-Oh, I see...

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: But they'd totally bug me about what[n]I'm buying if I did that. That's why[n]I work at the salon.

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: I get some good spending money,[n]plus the guys who come in there[n]like, mega pamper me.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Mega... pamper?

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: It's nice having people treat[n]you like you're special, y'know?

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: I'm sure a super honor student like[n]you gets that all the time though.

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: Anyways... are you gonna tell on me?[n]You even brought a witness today...

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: Hold up, doesn't that mean you[n]two were in Shinjuku together?

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: What's up with that, Miss Prez?
You have the wrong idea.[clr 27]
So what if we were together?
It's none of your business.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Right. It was nothing more than an[n]errand I asked him to accompany me on.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: H-Hey! Don't say things that could be[n]taken the wrong way.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It was simply an errand I asked[n]him to accompany me on. That's it.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: He's not wrong...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But allow me to at least clarify.[n]It was nothing more than an errand[n]I asked him to accompany me on.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: At any rate, don't mind him.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: As for you... I don't plan on[n]telling anyone.

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: Ohhh, I get it! So we're like,[n]protecting each other's secrets?

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: Oh crap, and I just realized your[n]boyfriend's that rumored criminal...[n]You're a real badass, Miss Prez!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I told you, that's not how it is!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I was just worried you were getting[n]wrapped up in some shady business, so[n]I asked him here for support.

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: Hmmm... Eh, whatever.

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: By the way, I was wondering...

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: Is that a Buchimaru-kun pencil case!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Huh? You know Buchimaru-kun...?

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: I had like, tonnns of Buchi stuff[n]back when I was a kid. What a[n]blast from the past!

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: Wait, why's it so beat up!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Well, it was given to me when I[n]was still in elementary school...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'd like to buy a new one, but they've[n]stopped selling Buchimaru-kun[n]merchandise.

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: OMG, this is too hilarious! The[n]student council president has[n]an adorable pencil case?

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: My image of you has done[n]like, a complete 360 today.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Um... isn't that a full circle?

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: Mmm, I dunno. I'm just real surprised.

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: You don't really look like the kinda[n]person who'd be into that stuff.

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: I mean, I always thought you were[n]kinda like a robot, but I guess I[n]just had to get to know you better.

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: Hey, why don't we trade phone numbers!?[n]I really wanna talk to you more about[n]Buchimaru-kun... and your boyfriend.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: O-Oh, um... Okay.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Wait, he's not my boyfriend...

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: Aaand saved!

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: Oh crap, it's this late already?[n]I've gotta get to work.

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: I'll send you tons of pics of my[n]Buchimaru-kun collection later[n]though. Bye byeee!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: She was all over the place...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Honestly though, I'm in shock.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: She thought I was a robot...
Don't let it get to you.
You can change.[clr 27]
Beep boop.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I won't. I'm aware of how one[n]could perceive me that way.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yes. That's why you're helping me.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Don't tease me!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You know, I believe what Takao-san said[n]about me is how others think as well.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I thought I had changed after[n]the incident with Kaneshiro,[n]but perhaps it wasn't enough...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That aside, it was almost inspiring to[n]meet someone so distinct from myself.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm going to try to look at things[n]a little differently from now on.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: And, well... I think that will[n]help me break out of my shell.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I hope you're ready. I'm going to[n]show you how useful an honor[n]student can really be.
I can sense a quiet resolve[n]from Makoto...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'll be interested to speak with[n]Takao-san some more now that[n]I have her contact information.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Perhaps I can correct her[n]misconceptions about you...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: And as always, I'll let you know[n]if anything important happens.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Well, see you later.
